{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Archaiad''''' was the national epic of the people of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. It may have recounted the unification of the planet by the [[Archais (kingdom)|Kingdom of Archais]]. It was noted for referring to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], or the "Axis" as it was called by the Alsakani, as "an arrow sent into the possible."<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
